name: Hridayarnava Rasa

sections.overview: Hridayarnava Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Hridayarnava Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to have mixture of herbs and minerals. This formulation is known to treat the problems related with heart.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Tamra Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Copper 

 To prepare water decoction from following: 

 Kakamachi – Solanum nigrum 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis 

 Method of preparation 

 Take mercury and Sulphur up to 10 gram and copper up to 20 grams. Powder all the ingredients and keep aside. 
 Take herbs vibhitaki, amalaki, kakamachi and haritaki. Make the water decoction of these herbs by boiling these herbs in water. Boil the water till the water volume is reduced up to one fourth level. After boiling process, filter the mixture and collect the filtrate. The decoction is prepared. 
 Now take the powdered ingredients and ground with water decoction. 
 After this process, take the paste up to 125 to 250 mg according to need, make pills from this and dry the pills in last.
sections.dose: One tablet one to two times a day, before or after meals, with kakamachi water decoction.
sections.indications:
Cardiac disorder with breathing difficulty 
 Heaviness in chest 
 Kapha related heart problems
sections.contraindications:
Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Hridayarnava Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Rasendrasara Sangraha Hridroga Chikitsa. 
 Introduction 
 Hridayarnava Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to have mixture of herbs and minerals. This formulation is known to treat the problems related with heart. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Tamra Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Copper 
 
 To prepare water decoction from following: 
 
 Kakamachi – Solanum nigrum 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Take mercury and Sulphur up to 10 gram and copper up to 20 grams. Powder all the ingredients and keep aside. 
 Take herbs vibhitaki, amalaki, kakamachi and haritaki. Make the water decoction of these herbs by boiling these herbs in water. Boil the water till the water volume is reduced up to one fourth level. After boiling process, filter the mixture and collect the filtrate. The decoction is prepared. 
 Now take the powdered ingredients and ground with water decoction. 
 After this process, take the paste up to 125 to 250 mg according to need, make pills from this and dry the pills in last. 
 
 Dose 
 One tablet one to two times a day, before or after meals, with kakamachi water decoction. 
 Indications 
 
 Cardiac disorder with breathing difficulty 
 Heaviness in chest 
 Kapha related heart problems 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
